name: velqyro-pay
description: VELQYRO PAY: plataforma de pagamentos (monólito modular).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @velqyro/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @velqyro/api" "npm run dev -w @velqyro/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @velqyro/shared && npm run dev -w @velqyro/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @velqyro/shared && npm run build -w @velqyro/api && npm run build -w @velqyro/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @velqyro/shared && npm run typecheck -w @velqyro/api && npm run typecheck -w @velqyro/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @velqyro/shared && npm run test -w @velqyro/api
